e_request_and_execution_contract.configured_profile: ForecastCalibrationProfile v1: profile_id, profile_version, exact request_ref, calibration_threshold, purpose='predictive_calibration'; profile artifact kind ir.forecast_calibration_profile, schema polisyos.calibration.forecast_calibration_profile v1.0. method.split: train_start, train_end, holdout_start, holdout_end, horizon; contiguous, explicit, horizon=holdout_end-holdout_start; at least eight train observations
method.execution: MethodRegistry + MethodDispatcher; only train rows are passed as state.series, exact FQN required, ComputeBackend.NUMPY required; persisted report predictions/intervals are reconciled to the train-only replay and actual holdout rows.
method.implementation_note: The ETS FQN uses the repository NumPy Holt-linear implementation; the local locked/installed statsmodels metadata is 0.14.6, but it is not the backend for this owner. No forecast or numeric call was run in this review.

source_measurement.required_snapshot: schema_version=2.0; explicit target_unit and target_scale='source_native'; DataSnapshot.data_schema_ref required.
source_measurement.schema_ref: fabric.data_schema / application/json / polisyos.fabric.DataSchema / schema 1.0; exactly one target_metric field; numeric scalar type; field unit.unit_id must equal target_unit.
source_measurement.scope_limit: This source-schema check establishes one metric coordinate and source-native unit. It does not establish C source admission, population/scope, completeness/version, or per-row forecast-time alignment.

rule.binding_note: The E empirical-context field named rule_version_ref currently carries the rule_id string. Backtest metadata separately includes calibration_rule_version and the actual calibration_rule_ref. A must resolve and bind the CAS rule object; the matching string alone is not rule-content proof.

temporal_roles.constraints: all distinct and timezone-aware; data_valid_time < calibration_window_start < calibration_window_end <= prediction_time < observation_time; policy_effective_time <= prediction_time
temporal_roles.limit: These are request-level times and are copied into report/evidence. E does not map each indexed observation to an actual timestamp from DataSchema or establish C source-time semantics.

e_request_and_execution_contract.scope: Request model_spec_ref and policy_spec_ref are optional as a pair, distinct if present; configured empirical profile execution requires both, and E resolves them as ir.model_spec / ir.policy_spec. The E scope-binding payload binds those IDs, method, estimand, rule ID, authority_scope and threshold; it is not an admitted C source-population profile.
e_request_and_execution_contract.manifest_inputs: Typed InputRef pairs, non-empty clean roles, no duplicate (artifact_id, role); the producer checks required source/data/schema/training/method/uncertainty/rule/model/policy/profile/request/evidence edges and resolves each report input.
e_request_and_execution_contract.train_only_and_holdout: ForecastOwner.run dispatches the registered method with only train values. It then checks exact horizon interval points, pairs each interval with its indexed actual holdout value, and recomputes coverage numerator/denominator/rate. This is empirical predictive interval coverage for this configured holdout, not causal-effect calibration or a causal estimate.

e_output_contract.report: ir.backtest_report / ir.backtest_report schema 1.0; E returns its ref, so an A method-result adapter must resolve/read the persisted report through CAS.
e_output_contract.empirical_evidence: ir.empirical_calibration_evidence / polisyos.calibration.empirical_calibration_evidence schema 1.1. Eight role-bound artifacts use schema 1.0: scope_binding, calibration_threshold, observed_outcome, prediction, evaluation_design, credible_evaluation, source_lineage, method_lineage. Their kinds are ir.calibration.<role> and schema names polisyos.calibration.<role>.
e_output_contract.candidate_receipt: ir.forecast_candidate_receipt / polisyos.calibration.forecast_candidate_receipt v1.0; verifier_provenance is Literal['not_established']; predictive_only; immutable denials include causal_effect_authority, treatment_assignment_authority, and s10_authority.
